remarks: Charming solid Cape off High Ridge Road just south of Rippowam Middle School. Enter the inviting living room with glistening hardwood floor just refinished, large front windows flanked by bookshelves, and a fireplace. Cozy sunroom/enclosed porch off the living room with access to the patio and pool area. Patio with in ground pool access, and a large fenced and sloping back yard. Separate dining room also with gleaming refinished hardwood floor. Kitchen back door leads to patio, pool, and back yard.  Down a several steps from living room to garage level, with washer and dryer and the oil burning furnace. Garage access from this level, and also a door to the side yard. Quiet neighborhood with no through traffic. Bedrooms are up a few stairs above the garage area, and a full hall bath. The private primary bedroom and its own half bath is up a few more stairs above the main floor living room, dining room, and kitchen. Property sold 'As Is'. Access to attic via pull-down stairs.
